Sam K: Quick heads-up — planning a small regional routing policy update for APAC edge tomorrow at 08:30 UTC. This is a gradual weight shift (hosted -> apac-edge) not a code push. Need deploy owner, smoke checker, and rollback ready.
Lee P: I can own the deploy window. ETA 30–45m including canary.
Maria G: I’ll run smoke tests and watch dashboards (latency, 5xx, error-rate). Which canary weight + step timing?
Sam K: Plan: 5% for 10m, 25% for 20m, 50% for 15m, final 100% if all green. If any step spikes >2x p50 or 5xx > 0.5% rollback immediately.
Raj S: On-call for APAC is @Raj S, I’ll be available during the window. Rollback plan is just reverse the weight policy and clear KV caches if needed.
Jen O: Add me for post-rollout verification — I’ll run synthetic traces and functional checks.
tim_bot: deploy-bot scheduled a routing-policy change ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ROUTE-2143 — window 2026-03-18 08:30 UTC.
Sam K: Preflight checklist (quick):
- confirm config in staging -> approved by @Lee P
- verify DNS TTL is 60s for apac.* records
- confirm canary telemetry dashboard link
- backup current routing policy (policy v42)
Please ack when you’ve validated your item.
Lee P: Staging config is green. I just pushed the canary policy to staging and ran smoke — all pass.
Maria G: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/apac/canary-edge?orgId=1 — I’ll watch p50/p95 and 5xx. Smoke suite: `curl https://apac.redwood.net/smoke/health` (should return 200 and json {"status":"ok"}).
Raj S: Confirmed TTL=60s for apac redwood host. I exported current policy: `policy export v42 > /tmp/policy-v42.json` and uploaded to ticket.
Jen O: I’ll start synthetic run at +10m after each step. Quick smoke script if needed:
```
#!/bin/bash
for n in {1..20}; do
  curl -s -f https://apac.redwood.net/health || exit 1
  sleep 15
done
```
Sam K: Good. Communication plan: post start, canary step updates every 10m in this thread. If somebody types `rollback` we stop and reverse immediately.
Lee P: I’ll kickoff at 08:31 UTC to give people a minute. I’ll post each step with weight and outcome.
Maria G: I’ll flag any anomalies with screenshots + metric delta. If p50 > 2x or 5xx > threshold I’ll write `rollback` in thread.
Raj S: Quick note on DNS: because TTL is 60s, DNS propagation should be fine for rollback decisions. Keep TTL low for the window.
Sam K: Post-rollout tasks: run full regression suite, bump TTL back to 300 after 1h steady, update runbook with any lessons.
Jen O: ACK — I’ll run the regression 1 hour after final 100% and capture traces.
Sam K: Thanks all — if no objections I’ll mark ticket READY and we proceed tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Lee P: ACK.
Maria G: ACK.
Raj S: ACK.
Jen O: ACK.
